 IN THE HIGH COURT OF GUJARAT AT AHMEDABAD  R/CIVIL APPLICATION (FOR CONDONATION OF DELAY) NO. 1750 of  2025  In F/FIRST APPEAL NO. 7071 of 2025  ==========================================================
 CHANDRAKALA PRABHUBHAI DAAIMA  Versus  RAHULBHAI PRAKASHBHAI BAGADA & ORS.
 ==========================================================
 Appearance:
 NISHIT A BHALODI(9597) for the Applicant(s) No. 1  ==========================================================
 CORAM:HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE DEVAN M. DESAI  Date : 09/04/2025  ORAL ORDER Heard learned advocate Mr. Nishit A. Bhalodi for the applicants.
2. The present application is filed for condonation of delay of 577 days in filing of the main matter.
3. At the outset, learned counsel for the applicants has submitted that additional affidavit dated 27.3.2025 is placed on record which contains the statement that the compensation amount was deposited by insurance company on 18.10.2023 before the learned tribunal and the amount was disbursed in NEUTRAL CITATION C/CA/1750/2025 ORDER DATED: 09/04/2025 undefined favour of the claimant on 8.11.2023.

sentences.text: The affidavit is taken on record.
It is further contended that because of scarcity of amount, the applicants could not pay necessary Court fees and expenses involved in filing the first appeal.

It is further contended that the concerned learned advocate sent affidavit for condonation of delay on 24.8.2023 and the said affidavit came to be executed before the Chandrakala Prabhubhai Daaima vs Rahulbhai Prakashbhai Bagada on 9 April, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/125286069/

sentences.text: Notary by the applicant on 22.3.2024.
Thereafter, the present application was filed for condonation of delay.

It is submitted that after the receipt of the affidavit dated 22.3.2024, learned advocate was waiting for Vakalatnama to be sent by applicants and when the Vakalatnama was received by the learned advocate for the applicant, the present application was presented on 23.1.2025.

It is submitted that in the vehicular accident, the husband of claimant No.1 has expired and claimants being the widow and children of deceased are facing financial crisis and they are coming from tribal area, delay was caused.

It is further contended that the applicant shall not claim any interest on enhanced amount, if any, for the delayed period and they shall waive their right of claiming interest for such delayed period.

4. Having considered the submissions of learned advocate NEUTRAL CITATION C/CA/1750/2025 ORDER DATED: 09/04/2025 undefined for the applicant/s and on perusal of the application, it appears that the affidavit in support of the application was executed on 6.1.2024, however, the application for condonation of delay is presented on 1.3.2025.
It also appears that no explanation is forthcoming as to how after the affidavit was sworn in the year 2024, the application for condonation of delay was not presented immediately thereafter.

The explanation which is given by learned advocate for the applicant for such gap is that the Vakalatnama was not received alongwith the affidavit and the same was received in the month of January, 2025.
Thereafter, the application was presented.
Such explanation though sounds attractive but has no force because on perusal of Vakalatnama of the applicant, the date is mentioned as 22.3.2024.
Further so far as question of arranging funds are concerned, as per the additional affidavit, they have received compensation on 8.11.2023.
Therefore, there is no reason of scarcity of funds also vanitious.

5. While deciding the application for condonation of delay, the Court has to be lenient and the explanation which has been given by the applicants for condonation of delay is to be viewed in a liberal manner.

The First Appeal is arising out of NEUTRAL CITATION C/CA/1750/2025 ORDER DATED: 09/04/2025 undefined claim compensation and the proceedings under the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 being a benevolent legislation, a lenient view is required to be adopted while considering the explanation.

6. In the present case, the explanation which is forthcoming is not genuine but just with a view to see that the claimants are not deprived off their rights to claim more compensation, by taking a lenient view, delay is condoned subject to cost of Rs.5,000/- (Rupees five thousand only) to be deposited by the claimants before the Secretary, Gujarat High Court Legal Services Committee on or before 23.4.2025.
